title: This app help me a lot but I have a few suggestions
body:
This app is really great for building positive habits, especially with its reward system that lets you earn money to buy clothes and decorate your Finch’s room.

However, I have a suggestion for improvement. It would be nice to add snacks or food as another type of reward for Finch, so it feels more like we are actually feeding and taking care of it. This would make the experience of nurturing Finch feel more engaging and personal.

Additionally, it would be great to include a feature where we can bathe Finch and keep it clean. This could strengthen the sense of bonding with Finch even more, similar to games like Pou where you can directly care for your virtual pet.

I hope the developers will consider these suggestions.
